title: The regulatory logic linking inflammation and fibrosis.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py. Europe PMC flags show no open access, no PMCID, no supplement, no data links, no text-mined accessions, and no NCBI (GEO/SRA/BioProject) links. The Zenodo/Dryad search on the DOI returned nothing.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: The abstract says it is a review that proposes a conceptual framework for immune-fibroblast crosstalk in fibrosis across heart, lung, liver and kidney. It reports no new dataset.

a1_downloadable.note: This is a review article. No dataset, supplement or repository accession exists, and the full text is paywalled with no PMC copy (checked via Europe PMC and NCBI links).

a2_label_is_a_column.note: There is no data, so there is no label column.

a5_enough_rows.note: No data, so there are no rows to count.

honest_claim_h3: None: a review with no data supports no model claim.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use single-cell gene activity from injured organs to predict whether tissue heals or scars; this paper offers no data for it.
plain_idea.train_on: Nothing from this paper. It would need public single-cell atlases of fibrotic tissue from elsewhere. Number of examples: unknown.
plain_idea.predict: Whether a tissue resolves or turns fibrotic (scarred). This review provides no measured outcome.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Fibrosis researchers would care, but the paper is a conceptual review. Any project would rest entirely on other datasets.

ml_idea: None from this paper. It is a review with no attached data.
